Cross-posting checklist
  • Same title, same accent word, every platform.
  • 4:5 for the feed, 9:16 for stories, 16:9 for YouTube — never letterbox one into another.
  • The handle bar sits in the same place on every post.
  • Alternate light and dark down the grid, or it turns into a wall.
  • One accent word per canvas. Still.

the grammar travels; only the crop changes
